about: THE RIVER BAKE, pinned: the engine's (src/sim/worldwater.cpp BakeRiversLakes) output for the rivers and lakes below on a copy of the peaks map, as `sandvox --mapcheck` reports it. Every profile is undecimated (one entry per 4-voxel sample), so `ground` is the bare ground the engine sampled at every sample. scripts/test_riverbake.mjs feeds it to assets/editor/riverbake.js and requires s, y (the water surface), reaches, pieces, waterfalls, endLevel, lakeIn / lakeOut and each lake's outline size + bbox to match exactly. Written by scripts/gen_river_vectors.py.

warnings: river "coast_trib": its surface at the junction was up to 58 voxels below "coast_run"'s (271); clamped to it
